title: Cat in a Box (Ethereum) — QC-3 adversarial re-audit: closure stands (E-U today <= $0.08 gross; latent 302 stETH overhang needs boxETH <= 0.9568)

Converting own collateral into boxETH costs 1:1, worse than the market. No value creation.

Deployed-bytecode dispatcher selectors == verified source for all six core contracts (no hidden/unguarded functions); all 12 deployer contract creations enumerated (CDP0 = 223 wei; 5 MortgageFi contracts = unrelated, $26.31 USDC dust).

boxFEE shares trading below 0.1016 boxETH-equivalent (0.9568 x NAV 0.10627) - no market exists today.

caveats: USD values use stETH $2,542.62 (as prior); price moves scale the USD figures.
The flat-price conditional table is an upper bound (unlimited depth); realisable extraction is measured on-fork (QC2/2b/2c) and is <= $0.08 gross.
The +0.00459 WETH historical arb at block 26066190 is gross of gas; at ~2M gas it was marginal/possibly gas-negative, and it occurred at a venue that no longer holds liquidity.
Read-only: no mainnet transactions were signed or sent; no secrets printed or stored.
one_liner: Adversarial re-audit of Cat in a Box: closure stands - today no keyless route extracts more than $0.08 gross (global optimum across every live venue and all 45 borrowers), the 302 stETH / $767,950 overhang needs ~315.7 boxETH at <=0.9568 stETH vs 9.76 boxETH of pool depth today (~30,000x gap), and the one fresh lead (a Trader Joe LB pair the prior missed) was a ~$11.7 gross bot arb that has since been drained.
